deadline.value: Applications close December 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM Eastern.
deadline.quote: December 1, 11:59 p.m. Eastern Standard Time (This deadline is for applications for enrollment beginning in fall 2027)

also.quote: While the application is for Fall 2027 enrollment, all associated deadlines fall within the 2026 calendar year (e.g., November 15, 2026)

gre_general.value: The department requires the General GRE, with no minimum score.
gre_general.quote: The submission of GRE general test scores is required for admissions.

gre_subject.value: The Chemistry or Physics Subject Test is optional.
gre_subject.quote: Subject Test in Chemistry or Physics - Optional/Not Required

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by a faculty review committee on the whole application.
supervisor.quote: the standardized scores are reviewed as part of the applicant's portfolio by the faculty review committee

funding.value: All admitted students receive full financial support for the length of their PhD (fellowship, teaching and advisor support).
funding.quote: All students receive full financial support for the length of their course of study

entry_route.value: The pages do not state whether applicants come straight from a bachelor's degree.

notes: The Graduate School deadline is in the Fields of Study entry; the department page mentions a December 1 deadline for November GRE results.
